create_config_stablelm: create a StableLmConfig instance with default model parameters for the stablelm-3b style configuration
create_config_custom_stablelm: create a StableLmConfig instance with custom vocab_size, hidden_size, and num_hidden_layers
create_config_rope_params: create a StableLmConfig instance with custom rope_parameters and partial_rotary_factor for rotary embedding configuration
create_config_attention_bias: create a StableLmConfig instance with use_qkv_bias and qk_layernorm enabled for attention layer configuration
create_config_residual_dropout: create a StableLmConfig instance with use_parallel_residual and hidden_dropout for parallel residual formulation
